question:
Which scheme among the following is most beneficial to the customer?

i) Successive discounts of 25% and 25%

ii) Flat discount of 40%

iii) Buy one, get one free

iv) Successive discounts of 30% and 20%
solution:
**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = (1-d1/100) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P.

Discount = ( M.P. -S.P.)

Discount% = ( Discount/M.P.) × 100 

Where, S.P.= Selling price, M.P. = Marked Price 

d1 and d2 are successive discounts respectively

**CALCULATION :**

Let us assume the Marked price to be Rs100 

on considering (i), we have

d1 = 25% , d2 = 25% M.P. = 100

⇒ S.P. = ( 1- 25/100) × ( 1- 25/100) × 100 = 3/4 × 3/4 × 100 = Rs56.25
